title: Bledsoe group films moving dots weeks later

tellings.quote: few weeks later and did the exact same thing without me there and and and then they were able to film dots in the sky

plain: A congressman named Eric Burlison says that a group around a man named Chris Bledsoe went back to the lawn of the US Capitol in Washington a few weeks after an outing Burlison had joined. They did "the exact same thing" without him and, he says, this time they filmed dots moving in the sky. Burlison repeats what the group told him, and he tells it as a sign that whatever they saw the first time came back.
